title: Planetpixy
body:
📢 Planetpixy SMP Modpack!

The Planetpixy SMP Pack is now available to level up your experience on the server!
It’s optional, but highly recommended if you want smoother visuals, better performance, and enhanced gameplay.

⚠️ Important:
To make sure all custom textures, UI designs, and visual elements show correctly, the Planetpixy SMP Pack resourcepacks are required.
Without them, certain visuals may not load as intended.

🌍 What’s Inside?

✨ Enhanced Visuals
Improved lighting, textures, and smoother animations for a more immersive world.

🔧 Quality of Life Upgrades
Less grind, better interactions, and smoother in-game flow.

🧩 Custom Mechanics
More depth, more variety, and expanded features without breaking vanilla balance.

🚀 Performance Boosts
Optimized settings to keep everything running stable, even with heavy visual mods.

While the modpack itself is not mandatory, it will definitely upgrade your SMP journey.
Just don’t forget to activate the Planetpixy SMP resourcepacks before hopping in!
